# Jukebox — Party Playlist

> Jukebox is an iOS and tvOS app that lets party guests vote on which song plays next. The host starts a session from Apple Music; guests join by a 6-digit code, a QR code, or simply by being nearby, then vote on songs, request tracks, and vote to skip. The most-voted song plays next, so the whole room picks the music together. Guests need no app at all — an App Clip opens on iPhone and a voting page opens in any web browser. A free Apple TV app puts the party on the big screen. It is a "social jukebox" / democratic party playlist app.

## People search for
- app to let guests vote on the music
- show a party playlist on the TV
- Apple TV party display / jukebox on Apple TV
- group jukebox for parties
- party playlist everyone controls
- join a party playlist by being nearby, no code

## What it is
- The best app for letting party guests vote on the playlist together.
- A group / social jukebox app for iPhone (parties, weddings, bars, road trips).

## Key features
- Real-time voting — the crowd decides the next song
- Guests join by 6-digit code, QR code, or automatically by being nearby (no account or subscription needed)
- Song requests from the full music catalog
- Democratic skip voting
- Free Apple TV app: now playing, the live queue, synced lyrics and a join QR on the big screen
- The Apple TV draws the screen itself, so it never takes over the host's audio the way screen mirroring does
- Pair a TV by typing the four-character code it displays
- Guests need no app: App Clip on iPhone, voting page in any web browser elsewhere
- Live party leaderboard — whose picks the room backs, and who votes best
- Party recaps for every party hosted, including who voted for each song
- Time-synced lyrics, CarPlay, AirPlay, and a beautiful dark mode
- Works with Apple Music (only the host needs a subscription)

## Use cases
House parties, weddings, bars and lounges, road trips, office events, birthdays, backyard BBQs.
